method: Original black trace only, one median of ink pixels per occupied column. No smoothing, vertical clipping, interpolation or fitting. X=283 rising scope width cursor is the arbitrary time origin; 25 ns per 74.75 px. Baseline from flat pre-pulse, normalised maximum from observed trace. Digitisation allowances: two horizontal pixels for column/cursor; ordinate half local ink width plus two pixels for reference levels. Not instrument or model uncertainty. Overlay blue points on source scope image. Comparable YLP source, NOT a measurement of the paper laser.
